readiness.hed: Mostly cloudy skies hold over Fredericksburg into Sunday evening near 55, with a clear, mild stretch moving in behind it through Tuesday
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this afternoon. Today stays mostly cloudy with a high near 55, then skies turn partly cloudy overnight with a low around 35. Monday and Tuesday both turn sunny and milder, with highs near 60 and 63 and clear, cool nights down into the low 30s — a calm, dry stretch heading into the new week.
actions: Northwest wind around 7 mph this evening is light, but it is a good night to double-check that any loose holiday decorations or yard items are secured before dark.
Overnight lows in the low-to-mid 30s tonight and Monday night mean sensitive plants and exposed outdoor spigots are worth covering before bed.
Sunday evening through Tuesday stays dry and clear — a solid window for evening church activities, outdoor errands or travel before any new system moves in.
Morning temperatures near freezing Monday and Tuesday mean a scraper in the car and a coat for the kids at the bus stop are worth keeping handy.
